[P2] Add caller/callee integration coverage for propagation

This fake client completes invokes without running a callee, while the serializer regression checks only outgoing JSON. The added tests therefore pass even if the backend ignores `XAmznTraceId`, loses `Sampled=0`, or fails to connect the target to the calling operation. This public transport change needs the integration coverage required by CONTRIBUTING.md. Add a deployed caller/callee example and integration test that captures the received carrier and verifies trace identity, calling-operation ancestry, and sampled/unsampled behavior for both OTel views.
